doc: I57 (frozen at the I57 prereg; pinned by sha256 in the key I57 and in tests_m5/test_i57_environment.py PINNED): the three environment modules that I57 builds, one per L9 category, as module records of spec/M5/lib/inputs.schema.json#/$defs/module_record. Every parameter is a premise taken from a cited specification or from the target's code, never fitted to observations (I54 L9 R6); the measuring key I57 pins the same values in thresholds.pinned_parameters. A parameter is a premise of the laws that cite the module, not a fact about mainnet (BUILD_PLAN I57 risk). producers: the code that wrote or chose by the module's parameter (I54 L9 R1: an observation set from one of them is not truth for the module). The observation tool spec/M5/lib/I57_observe.py never reads this file.

modules.citation: W in beacon slots: MIN_EPOCHS_FOR_BLOB_SIDECARS_REQUESTS (4096 epochs) x SLOTS_PER_EPOCH (32), the consensus specification's minimum retention of blob sidecars (Deneb p2p-interface; kept by Fulu for data column sidecars). holon/historical/fetch.py RETENTION_SLOTS is the same value, so holon.historical.fetch is a producer. The window family predicts retrievable iff q - t <= W: an exact window, not a lower bound.

d in L1 execution blocks: the target's derivation default, node/derivation/config.go DefaultConfirmations = rpc.BlockNumber(10) (latest-10) at the pinned commit 3e44e795586af3e11285b603ab642c67823add51 of the checkout config/holon.json extract.sources names. The premise: a block at least d below the head stays canonical.

the blob archive fetcher (the history source of spec/M2/lib/historical.json sources.blob_archive): asked for a versioned hash, it returns exactly the committed blob (the KZG-checked bytes) and nothing for a hash that no transaction committed.
